{{Top|leg}}
'''Spelunking''' was the activity of exploring caves and underground tunnels. Spelunking could be dangerous. In a widely publicized incident, four spelunkers became trapped in the [[Keen's Grotto/Legends|Keen's Grotto catacombs]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and had to be rescued by a search and rescue squad, who deployed a [[GV/3-series guardian droid]] to save them.<ref name="TEGtD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
